title: Ethiopian Stew
description: A flavorful and hearty stew made with berbere spice and a variety of vegetables, perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onions and garlic and cook until softened.
Add berbere spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add lamb broth, carrots, and potatoes.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add lemon juice and stir to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Simmer stew according to package instructions.
Serve stew over rice or with naan bread.
